ntrs_source.linking_rule:
(deliberately conservative): an NTRS citation is linked to a PSI
investigation only if its title or abstract contains the investigation acronym
as a whole token (e.g. 'BASS-II', 'FLEX-2', 'Saffire-I'; case-sensitive for
short or common-word acronyms such as 'SAME') or the investigation's full title
or sub-title phrase (e.g. 'Burning Rate Emulator'), AND a combustion word
(flame|fire|smoke|combust|burn|soot|extinction). For records
without an acronym, NTRS is searched by title and a hit is linked only when
>= 60% of the title's content words appear in the NTRS title.
